description: Upload or rotate the mTLS client certificate for a connector. This is an upsert: if credentials already exist they are REPLACED and the connection is re-established. It cannot be used to remove credentials - the payload is required. Certificates and keys are PEM-encoded; the private key is never returned by any read tool.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

client_key.description: PEM-encoded private key (PKCS8, RSA or EC).

name: mba_upsert_connector_certificate
title: Set connector mTLS certificate
